limits: Original update/query, state getter and eighteen helper entries execute unhooked until actual JNI table endpoints.
Each update/query pair retains state and compares full buffers/pages, native endpoint identity and full query return with independent expected values.
Raw float/double fixtures are test-only. Sampled payloads, default MXCSR and multiplication operand order do not prove complete NaN or floating exception behavior.
Typed local UI/settings and their shared controls are checked by a separate report. Metadata discovery, descriptor initialization, hook/event installation, ownership and concurrency remain open.
